column1: # autoverify: original vs rebuilt AttT exe, function by function.  Run:
#   python3 decomp/tools/autoverify.py ATThrone.exe rebuild.exe rebuild.map AUTO_DIR WORK OUT.tsv
#   (--n 30 --shard k/24 for the full sweep, --only ADDR,... to re-check single functions, --resume to continue)
# status: verified    return registers, untouched registers and all written memory equal on every case
#         lowcov      every case ended in a fault on both sides (fuzz-only garbage input), no diff observed
#         unsupported the function calls an import the emulator does not model (C++ iostreams, Bink, ...)
#         differs / faultdiff  a real difference in at least one case
# --- re-check of every divergence classified in the build35-37 sweeps, against build42 (2026-11-01, 30 cases)
# 12 verified, 4 lowcov (both sides fault on every fuzz case), 1 unsupported, 0 differs: the later pipeline fixes
# (float rounding around CRT math arguments and returns, _ftol as int, the fixed difftest x87 stack and
# __sse2_available) removed them.  The table below keeps the *historical* build37 verdicts with the cause, so a
# regression shows up as a known class instead of a new mystery.

column4: build37: faultdiff - Ghidra printed an ordered x87 compare as a C float compare; a NaN input left the original in a lookup loop and the C took the other branch
build37: faultdiff - same class (dot product then linked-list scan)
build37: faultdiff - same class, dot <= 0.0 kept the original in the inner loop on NaN
build37: faultdiff - this==0 -> the original read the vtable from [0] and called through it; the C dereference faulted earlier/later.  build42: both fault on all 30 cases
build37: differs - a random heap dword became the virtual target and was executed as code; call vs tail-jmp differed only in the stack leftovers the garbage code saw
build37: faultdiff - the original divides by a zero vector length (`div esi`), #DE; C division by zero is UB and clang drops/never traps
build37: faultdiff - original `idiv ecx` with the power result 0; the C `1 / (longlong)x` made clang assume x != 0
build37: faultdiff - element load whose value only feeds a no-op callee (00432EA0 is a bare `ret`, mis-prototyped as custom EAX); the load was dead in C
build37: faultdiff - `for (i = 0; i < n; i++) ;` with no side effects; clang deletes it, the original burns n iterations.  Now the function is unsupported: calls _vsnprintf
build37: differs - the differing dword is an MSVCP80 allocator/string header field (0x08 vs 0xE8) written by emulated std::string code, not by the function's own logic
build37: differs - NaN/garbage-pointer math: the original stored -NaN to computed low-memory addresses, the C reached other addresses after the first NaN comparison

build37: differs - (uint)(float) out of range: MSVC _ftol2 yields 0x80000000, clang's 64-bit fistp took the low 32 bits -> another grid cell, on garbage coordinates only.  build42: 1 ok + 29 both faulted

build37: differs - Ghidra printed the term order of a float sum rotated; with FPCW=0x7F (single precision, set by D3D9 without FPU_PRESERVE) the original grouped ((f2^2+f3^2)+f4^2), the C ((f4^2+f2^2)+f3^2) -> last-bit difference on 15000 garbage vertices

build37: differs - the descending sort's quicksort partition split differed on arrays whose keys all tie or are NaN, but the caller 005B2D60 ended with the same sorted array (100 random cases, orig == new)
build37: faultdiff - the original read a garbage pointer before its count check; clang sank/removed the load.  build42: 1 ok + 29 both faulted
